scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (Test-Path local.properties)) { $cands = @('../local.properties', '../../local.properties'); foreach ($c in $cands) { if (Test-Path $c) { Copy-Item $c local.properties; break } } }; python scripts/security_check.py --all"
